description:
Summary:

Add OpOverloadPacket check in is_impure() before OpOverload check.
When FX symbolic_trace resolves ops, it produces OpOverloadPacket targets
(e.g., torch.ops.fb.assert_tensor) rather than OpOverload targets.
Without this fix, eliminate_dead_code() would remove these nodes
even when they are registered in _side_effectful_functions.

The new check first looks up the packet directly in
_side_effectful_functions, then delegates to the default overload.

Test Plan:
Two new tests in test_dce_pass.py verify packet-level DCE
survival with both full registration and packet-only registration.
